reviews.comment: Dr. Knappett is a decent guy but a scatterbrained lecturer with an equally disorganized course. The material is really broad and exams are challenging, with weekly writing labs that are very tedious. Try to find a different professor if you can, or be prepared to teach yourself most of the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He was a very nice prof but seemed very timid when speaking to his students. He often went on tangents during lecture, and had some difficulty explaining some content. There was a mandatory writing lab, which wasn't hard, but attendance was required. This was the first semester he implemented a final exam for this course and it was very difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Knappett is a nice guy but very disorganized. His slides were completely out of order and he would alternate between rushing through confusing equations and going on tangents. He spent half a class yapping about roman water pipes. He didn't grade that hard but you have to teach yourself. We had a group paper instead of a final.

yapper. spoke to him about renewables and he shifted the conversation to vegetarianism within the span of 5 minutes. didn't show up to the office hours time stated in the syllabus. could not follow his lectures because they were so confusing and the way he explained made it worse. content itself is easy. self study and workload is manageable.

Dr. Knappett really isn't a bad professor, but going to his lectures often left me more confused because of his tangents that felt too complex and unnecessary. The class felt unreliable: we were always behind on lectures, exam dates would change, due dates changed, slides were never concrete and changed too. Made class more difficult than it was.
I am taking GEOL610 this semester. This course is a total waste of time !!! Please don't look forward to learning anything new from his course. You know much more than him.

Nice guy, bad prof. Super disorganized. He constantly contradicted himself and the TA in class. He would say something wouldn't be on an exam then it would be. He made the class way harder and more stressful than it should have been. He seemed consistently surprised by the content on his exams and homework. Easy extra credit.
Dr. Knappett really cares about the content that he teaches.

Love Dr. Knappett because he's a funny guy with a library of Canada jokes, but he is a rambler. Lots of information from lecture would get lost in translation because he'd start going on technical or mathematical tangents that didn't relate to the class itself. But you can feel the passion he has for knowledge, and he likes to learn from students!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Nice guy, not the best prof. Rambles each lecture make it hard keeping up and understanding what's actually relevant. He plans the semester as it goes, but trips up and confuses the class sometimes. And it really sucked getting the exam review one day before the only exam in the course. Fun and interactive though, for sure take him if you have to.

The truth is while this class isn't difficult, Knappett makes it obnoxious. Very little feedback and delayed feedback when there is some. Just received a final paper grade...5 months later midway into a new semester. Save yourself and take this class under someone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Knappett is nice, but is very unorganized. Although he is one of the nicest professors I've had at TAMU, his disorganization left me consistently on edge considering my grade. He forgot several times to email me and even give back my grades. Literally had to wait and see what I had made when grades were posted at the end of the semester.

Knappett was probably my favorite professor of the semester. He is really passionate about hyrdrogeology and really knows the material well. He tries really hard to always present material in an understandable way and give correct and understandable answers to any questions asked in class. The class is also pretty chill. He accepts late work too.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Knappett is a really sweet guy but just has a timid personality, unusual for a prof. Only grades were a midterm, Final, group debate, and 3 hw assignments (+writing lab grades), but all-in-all these things were easy if you put minimal effort into them. Study hard for the midterm and final and actually do the hw and you'll be make an A or B.
Not a good teacher. Doesn't present well. Homework is nearly impossible and anything he gives as "hints" are impossible to understand.

Text reviews did not match tests.  Grading was inconsistent.  Not available.  Let class to TA to take vacation and out of country assignments.  Did not offer extra credit.  Wasn't willing to work with those willing to do extra credit.
